svg.aria-label: From every DRM file descriptor to one gauge per card: 1. Scan: Each scrape of /metrics walks every /proc/pid on the node. Nothing is cached, so each reading is live. 2. Find: For each process it reads fd links and keeps the ones pointing at a /dev/dri renderD or card node, then reads their fdinfo. 3. Sum: Only clients with drm-driver xe count, once each. It adds drm-total-vram0 and drm-total-gtt per card and per pod UID. 4. Export: It emits xe_gpu_vram_used_bytes, xe_gpu_gtt_used_bytes, xe_gpu_clients and per-process series. The card total comes from XE_VRAM_TOTALS_MIB.
